missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Артист' is nominative as the subject of 'вышел'. 'Известный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'на сцену' is the accusative destination.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Артиста' takes the genitive-shaped accusative because the performer is animate masculine. 'Зрители' is the nominative plural subject of 'ждали'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Артиста' is genitive after 'у' to show whose talent it is. 'Этого' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Артисту' is the dative indirect object receiving the flowers. 'Цветы' is the accusative direct object, and 'дети' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Артистом' takes the instrumental after 'с' for the verb 'познакомился'. 'Этим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'Артисте' uses the prepositional form after 'об' to mark the topic. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Артисты' is nominative plural as the subject of 'работают'. 'Молодые' agrees in the plural, and 'в театре' is the location.

missions.phrase: Мы видели на концерте трёх артистов.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Animate genitive plural after numeral. 'Артистов' takes the genitive plural after 'трёх' because the performers are animate. 'На концерте' is the location.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Артист' is nominative as the subject. 'Талантливый' is the agreeing masculine predicate adjective, intensified by 'очень'.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative object. 'Артиста' is the animate accusative direct object of 'пригласил', matching the genitive form. 'Нового' agrees in the masculine animate accusative.
